hooks.name: Commit and Push After Task
hooks.description: After a spec task is completed, commits all changes with a descriptive conventional commit message and pushes to the current branch

action.prompt: A task was just completed. Stage all changes with git add -A, then commit with a descriptive conventional commit message (feat/fix/docs/refactor scope and short description), then push to the current branch. Do not ask for permission — just commit and push.
